messages:
maya: quick pulse  we need a refreshed run-of-show for the Dedicated deployments webinar. open to changing flow from last time.
raj: favorite angle = "stories + numbers". short social-friendly benchmark stat up front, then 2 customer stories (one EU/regulatory) + breakout lab.
claire: got one EU customer (Nexa Med) who can do live Q&A in CET. they can present in English but want a localized abstract for EMEA landing page. I can write EN/FR/DE abstracts.
josh: speaker availability constraint: Sam (demo owner) free windows Mon 10:30-11:15 PT & Tue 08:00-09:00 PT. prefer Mon for production smoke.
zoe: ops: prefer 45min slot so we can include a 15-min hands-on breakout with 3 tiny labs. attendees choose path at registration.
maya: proposed RoS (45m): 1) 1m intro + housekeeping, 2) 6m benchmark highlight + why it matters, 3) 12m customer story A (US), 4) 10m live demo (Sam), 5) 10m breakout lab instructions + labs start, 6) 6m panel recap + CTA. good?
raj: swap labs before live demo? labs need infra creds. worry about timing. maybe run labs in parallel while demo runs (attendees opt-in).
claire: abstract drafts: short paragraph + three bullets (what you'll learn) + one gov/reg compliance note for Nexa. I'll drop drafts by EOD Thu.
josh: rehearsal plan: 40m tech run + 20m content run on day-before. need playback test for pre-recorded captions and multi-language intro.
zoe: lead routing plan: registrants -> HubSpot list "dedicated_webinar_2026"; attended -> add property webinar_attended=true; clicked-trial or asked-demo -> tag "hot_webinar". SDRs get automatic task within 6 hours. ops-bot: automation queued: create HS list + onboarding task rule.
maya: marketing assets: 1) social launch post (X, LinkedIn) w/ bench stat, 2) landing page copy (EN+localized), 3) demo GIF for CTAs. Raj you own stat verification + dev to produce GIF.
raj: will verify bench stat (end-to-end batching + KV cache) and share measurement approach (dataset, seq len) in the repo. provisional stat: "2-3x token cost reduction" until verified.
claire: speakers: need 2-sentence bios + headshots + pronouns by Mon. also capture one-line talk summary for slide deck.
sam: can do live demo but request 10-min dry run slot with prod-like traffic. prefer Thu 09:00 PT rehearsal.
josh: booked: Thu 09:00 PT rehearsal (demo smoke) & Sun 16:00 PT content rehearsal. invites sent. includes checklist: VPN off, local recording, stable ethernet.
zoe: post-event playbook: immediate email with recording + 2 pager; 24h personalize for hot leads; 72h SDR outreach cadence; 2-week nurture with lab invites. Ill draft templates and sequences.
maya: fallback plan: if live demo fails, switch to recorded demo + open floor to labs (increase interactivity). who will cut to recorded? Josh?
josh: I can trigger fallback. will keep a 1080p mp4 on hand and a shorter 3-min excerpt for social.
claire: labs: three tiny hands-on tasks: a) configure routing policy, b) run small perf bench, c) inspect cost breakdown in console. need step-by-step lab guide + quick-check answers. Ill author.
raj: also want a short benchmark narrative slide set: methodology, hardware, seq dist, batching config, and tradeoffs. keep 2 slides max for narrative.
ops-bot: reminder: upload intro captions + localized abstracts by Thu 18:00 PT; rehearsal Thu 09:00 PT; content run Sun 16:00 PT; webinar Mon 11:00 PT.
maya: volunteer for Q&A moderation? need someone to triage, escalate product bugs to #eng-oncall, and flag demo leads.
sam: happy to moderate if Josh runs fallback.
josh: agreed. will prepare a triage doc with tags: sales-lead, product-bug, follow-up-request.
zoe: final note  for landing page CTA use UTMs: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=landing, utm_campaign=dedicated_launch. I'll add to link.
maya: perfect. thanks team. keep updates here. :sparkles:
